name: airpulse
description: AirPulse Global Air Quality Risk Intelligence Platform

scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently --kill-others --names "API,UI" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "./.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.api.main:app --reload --port 8000" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:pages: npx -y wrangler pages dev dist --cwd frontend
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run export:static && npm run build && npx -y wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=airpulse --cwd frontend
